summary.en: Iceland weather changes rapidly; strong winds, rain, and sudden temperature drops are common, especially in winter.
summary.zh: 冰岛天气变化迅速；强风、降雨和突然降温很常见，尤其是在冬季。

mitigations.en: Check weather forecasts (vedur.is) before heading out, especially for remote areas.
mitigations.zh: 出发前查看天气预报（vedur.is），特别是前往偏远地区时。

mitigations.en: Carry layered clothing: waterproof/windproof shell, warm mid-layer, thermal base layer.
mitigations.zh: 携带分层衣物：防水/防风外层、保暖中层、保暖内衣。

mitigations.en: Be prepared for sudden weather changes even in summer.
mitigations.zh: 即使在夏季也要为突然的天气变化做好准备。

mitigations.en: Avoid driving in severe weather conditions.
mitigations.zh: 避免在恶劣天气条件下驾驶。

summary.en: Geothermal areas (hot springs, geysers, volcanoes) present burn risks from hot ground and steam.
summary.zh: 地热区域（温泉、间歇泉、火山）存在高温地面和蒸汽造成的烫伤风险。

mitigations.en: Stay on marked tracks and boardwalks in geothermal areas.
mitigations.zh: 在地热区域请走在标记的路径和栈道上。

mitigations.en: Keep safe distance from geysers, hot springs, and steam vents.
mitigations.zh: 与间歇泉、温泉和蒸汽喷口保持安全距离。

mitigations.en: Supervise children and pets closely in thermal areas.
mitigations.zh: 在地热区域密切看管儿童和宠物。

mitigations.en: Be aware of unstable ground near thermal features.
mitigations.zh: 注意地热特征附近的不稳定地面。

summary.en: Remote areas have limited fuel and supply access; long distances between services, especially in the Highlands.
summary.zh: 偏远地区燃料和补给有限；服务点之间距离很长，特别是在高地地区。

mitigations.en: Plan fuel stops before entering remote areas (F-roads, Highlands).
mitigations.zh: 进入偏远地区（F 路、高地）前规划好加油站。

mitigations.en: Carry extra food, water, and emergency supplies.
mitigations.zh: 携带额外的食物、水和应急用品。

mitigations.en: Check road conditions (road.is) before heading to remote areas.
mitigations.zh: 前往偏远地区前查看路况（road.is）。

mitigations.en: Have offline maps and GPS backup.
mitigations.zh: 准备离线地图和 GPS 备用设备。

summary.en: Strong ocean currents and unpredictable waves at black sand beaches; river crossings in Highlands can be dangerous.
summary.zh: 黑沙滩的强洋流和不可预测的海浪；高地地区的河流穿越可能很危险。

mitigations.en: Never turn your back to the ocean at black sand beaches.
mitigations.zh: 在黑沙滩上永远不要背对大海。

mitigations.en: Stay away from the water's edge, especially at Reynisfjara.
mitigations.zh: 远离水边，特别是在雷尼斯黑沙滩。

mitigations.en: Do not attempt river crossings in Highlands without proper vehicle and experience.
mitigations.zh: 没有合适的车辆和经验，不要尝试在高地地区穿越河流。

mitigations.en: Check tide times and weather conditions before visiting coastal areas.
mitigations.zh: 访问沿海地区前查看潮汐时间和天气状况。

summary.en: F-roads (Highland roads) require 4x4 vehicles and are closed in winter; gravel roads and strong winds can be challenging.
summary.zh: F 路（高地道路）需要四驱车辆，冬季关闭；碎石路和强风可能具有挑战性。

mitigations.en: Rent appropriate vehicle (4x4 for F-roads, sturdy car for gravel roads).
mitigations.zh: 租用合适的车辆（F 路需要四驱车，碎石路需要坚固的车辆）。

mitigations.en: Check road conditions and F-road status before departure.
mitigations.zh: 出发前查看路况和 F 路状态。

mitigations.en: Drive slowly on gravel roads and be cautious of strong crosswinds.
mitigations.zh: 在碎石路上慢速行驶，注意强侧风。

mitigations.en: Never drive off-road or on closed roads.
mitigations.zh: 永远不要越野行驶或在封闭道路上行驶。

items.zh: 租用合适的车辆（F 路需要四驱车，碎石路需要坚固的车辆）

items.zh: 出发前查看路况和天气

items.zh: 在碎石路上慢速行驶，注意强侧风

items.en: Never drive off-road or on closed roads
items.zh: 永远不要越野行驶或在封闭道路上行驶

items.en: Be aware of sheep on roads, especially in rural areas
items.zh: 注意路上的羊，特别是在农村地区

items.en: Carry spare tire and know how to change it
items.zh: 携带备胎并知道如何更换

items.en: Never turn your back to the ocean at black sand beaches
items.zh: 在黑沙滩上永远不要背对大海

items.en: Stay away from the water's edge, especially at Reynisfjara
items.zh: 远离水边，特别是在雷尼斯黑沙滩

items.en: Check tide times and weather conditions before visiting coastal areas
items.zh: 访问沿海地区前查看潮汐时间和天气状况

items.en: Be aware of sneaker waves that can come far up the beach
items.zh: 注意可能冲到海滩深处的暗涌

items.en: Do not climb on basalt columns or unstable rock formations
items.zh: 不要攀爬玄武岩柱或不稳定的岩石构造

message.en: Iceland weather changes rapidly. Pack layered clothing: waterproof/windproof shell, warm mid-layer (fleece/wool), thermal base layer. Also carry headlamp, spare batteries, and emergency shelter for remote areas.
message.zh: 冰岛天气变化迅速。准备分层衣物：防水/防风外层、保暖中层（抓绒/羊毛）、保暖内衣。同时携带头灯、备用电池和偏远地区的应急庇护所。
